[Felix "Slow It Down" Lyrics] Oh I’m still so young and working day and night Man ain’t it so wild? Already like I’m running out of time World on fast forward Just trying to breathe I’m tryna keep up with something I can’t see I don’t know why but somehow it doesn’t feel right, feel right Thinking ’bout our hopes and dreams, yeah At the cost of you and me Can we slow it down a little The sky is moving quicker these days I’m tryna hold on to something, something The best times have only started And it’s too soon to say we’ve parted Can we all just hold on to something, something yeah Inside looking out Friends muckin’ around Ain’t got no one to share how I’m feeling now They say look at you A life to die for Yeah I’m blessed this I know But I’m still torn Kinda lost (It’s alright) Feeling crossed (Don’t worry) Dust it off (Alright) ’Cause when the lights and the camera turn on These something The best times have only started And it’s too soon to say we’ve parted Can we all just hold on to something, something yeah Can we all just hold on to something, something yeah Listen to
